annotations.title: What moved in the AI tools market

description: What changed among the tools in the INITE Atlas: prices up or down, free plans added or dropped, OpenAPI specs published, MCP servers listed. Each change was read twice from the vendor's own page or the public registry before it counts, and a correction somebody typed in is never reported as the vendor's move. Each list says how many tools were in a position to change at all.
